Name: Line Sprinklers Redux (1.6 Compatible)
Author: Swyytch
Description:
[size=6]Line Sprinklers Redux
[/size]A spiritual successor to the original Adds Straight Line Sprinklers which water in a single direction. The number of tiles watered is the same as vanilla sprinklers, just drawn out in a straight line:
[list]
[*][b]Basic Sprinklers: [/b]4 Tiles
[*][b]Quality Sprinklers: [/b]8 Tiles
[*][b]Iridium Sprinklers: [/b]24 Tiles
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5MLmvAF.png[/img]
[i]Shown in [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7497]Elle's Ideal Greenhouse

[/url][size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Compatible with most Sprinkler mods -[/b] The game is patched to consider these sprinklers, so most sprinkler mods should be compatible with Line Sprinklers Redux out of the box. If you find an incompatible mod, raise it in the comments and I'll take a look.[/size]
[*][size=3][i]﻿[/i][b]Rotatable - [/b]Sprinklers can be rotated while held, or after being placed. The hotkey for this can be configured with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url], but the default hotkey is [b]Middle Click[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Craftable - [/b]They unlock at the same time as the vanilla sprinklers. Each line sprinkler is configured from it's vanilla counterpart.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Recyclable - [/b]If you throw a line sprinkler in a Recycler, it will be recycled into a vanilla sprinkler of the same type.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Enricher & Pressure Nozzle Support - [/b]Enrichers are just like Vanilla. Pressure Nozzles double the range of the line sprinkler.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/rpbufkN.gif[/img]

﻿Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

Compatible with Stardew 1.6+, and the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. Known to be compatible with:
[list]
[*]UI Info Tweaks 2
[*]Data Layers
[*]Activate Sprinklers (though this mod handles it's own animations, so the animations are broken when manually activating or placing).
[*]most Sprinkler Mods.
[/list][size=5]
Translations
[/size][list]
[*]English
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian (by Roman0)
[*]French (by kevinmarrec)
[*]Simplified Chinese ( by yuki9977)
[*]Japanese (by Miruiro)
[/list][size=5]Help Wanted
[/size][list]
[*]Translations, and Translation Proof-reading
[*]Animations (if you can do better than me, feel free to submit a PR or send me a message)
[/list]
[size=5]For Mod Authors[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]You are welcome to add compatibility for Line Sprinklers Redux in any mod, without prior permission, as long as said compatibility requires this mod to be installed. This mod is open source under the MIT license, and assets can be used and modified as long as they are credited to the original author (Swyytch) with a link to this mod page or the github repository.[/size]
[*][size=2]Line Sprinklers Redux exposes an API which can be leveraged to directly invoke the sprinkler animation, apply the sprinkler's watering pattern, or determine if a `StardewValley.Object` is a Line Sprinkler. See [url=https://github.com/rtrox/LineSprinklersRedux/blob/main/LineSprinklersRedux/ILineSprinklersReduxAPI.cs]ILineSprinklersReduxAPI[/url] for more details.[/size]
[*][size=2]Line Sprinklers also patch the default Sprinkler Methods, so methods like `GetSprinklerTiles`, `IsSprinkler`, and `IsInSprinklerRangeBroadphase` will all Just Work without additional work from you.[/size]
[*][size=2]If there are other APIs which would be useful, feel free to make a post here, or open an issue on Github.[/size]
[/list][size=5]See Also[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/rtrox/LineSprinklersRedux]Source Code[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2917]Hootless' Line Sprinkler[/url]s﻿ [Deprecated, not 1.6 Compatible] - The mod that inspired this mod (note that no code or assets are re-used from the linked mod).[/size]
[/list]
